verdict.rationale: Marqeta's first-party authorization controls limit where users can transact, either to a single merchant or to a group of merchants. That directly covers single-merchant locks and merchant-group restrictions enforced as authorization controls, and the MCP server docs also list merchant restrictions as a spend control. missing for 10: explicit documentation of MCC-based groups, explicit allowlist vs. blocklist modes, detail on per-card scoping and authorization-time evaluation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
